dominant_cause.pinned_mechanism: Canonical Linux 4.19 kernel lacks CONFIG_EXT4_FS_POSIX_ACL=y; ext4 returns EOPNOTSUPP on setxattr('system.posix_acl_default')

guest_evidence.first_failing_line: 11-02 12:22:36.824   947   947 E vold    : Failed to set default ACL on /data/media/0: Operation not supported on transport endpoint
guest_evidence.error_string: Operation not supported on transport endpoint (EOPNOTSUPP)
guest_evidence.secondary_fault: UserDataPreparer.java:132 -> error rebooting into recovery -> IOException: Reboot failed (no permissions?) due to missing /misc partition

alternatives_ruled_out.mount_option_gap: In Linux 4.19 fs/ext4/super.c, Opt_acl is guarded by #ifdef CONFIG_EXT4_FS_POSIX_ACL. When unconfigured, passing acl mount option triggers '(no)acl options not supported'. Superblock default mount options (tune2fs -o acl) are ignored by kernel without the config.
alternatives_ruled_out.vold_side_misuse: Vold uses standard XATTR_NAME_POSIX_ACL_DEFAULT ('system.posix_acl_default'), path /data/media/0, and flags 0 per AOSP FUSE/storage spec. No namespace or flag misuse.
alternatives_ruled_out.subtree_location: In T666, /data/media resided directly on the ext4 /dev/loop2 /data mount without a dedicated mount point, subjecting it to ext4 xattr handlers.

pinned_mechanism.fix_layer: filesystem/mount arrangement: mount tmpfs on /data/media in early-ramdisk (mode=0770, uid=1023, gid=1023), verified in t636-diag.sh. Kernel CONFIG_TMPFS_POSIX_ACL=y sets SB_POSIXACL on tmpfs, so setxattr succeeds. /data remains ext4 on /dev/loop2, preserving user.serial ENODATA semantics.
